_note: Single source of truth for the production origins. Fill these in on deploy day,
then run: node tools/deploy-origins.mjs --apply && node sync-shared.mjs
An origin is scheme + host, with no trailing slash and no path.
Placeholders are deliberate: --apply refuses to run while any is left, so a half
filled file cannot produce a half switched site.
